concepts.name: problem
concepts.description: A situation or task that requires a solution.

concepts.name: solution
concepts.description: An answer or method that solves a problem.

concepts.name: case
concepts.description: A stored (problem, solution) experience. May or may not be a *successful* solution.

concepts.name: memoryStore
concepts.description: A collection of recorded cases for retrieval and reuse.

concepts.name: indexingMethod
concepts.description: A strategy for organising and retrieving cases efficiently.

concepts.name: discriminationTree
concepts.description: An indexing method that splits cases by feature tests in a tree structure.

concepts.name: coordinateIndex
concepts.description: An indexing method that organises cases in a multidimensional feature space, referring to them as ordered tuples (x_1, x_2, ..., x_n) in n dimensions.

relations.name: stores
relations.description: Indicates that the memory store contains the case.

relations.name: retrieves
relations.description: Indicates that the case can be retrieved from the memory store.

relations.name: adaptsFrom
relations.description: Indicates that the solution was adapted from a prior case.

assertions.name: isWellFormed
assertions.description: Checks that a problem is syntactically and semantically valid.

assertions.name: solved
assertions.description: Indicates that a solution successfully solves its problem.

assertions.name: contains
assertions.description: States that a memory store includes a given problem-solution pair.

assertions.name: size
assertions.description: Returns the number of elements in the collection.

instances.name: exampleMemory
instances.description: An example memory store initially containing no cases.

instances.name: routeMemoryTable
instances.description: Memory store for the route finding problem, organised as a 2D table.

instances.name: routeMemoryTree
instances.description: Memory store for the route finding problem, organised as a decision tree.
